title: Epistemic Sybil Resistance: Multiplying AI Agents Without Multiplying Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2609.01873v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent AI systems improve inference by spawning agents and synthesizing reports. But another agent is not another observation: apparently independent reports may descend from the same evidence, and genuinely independent evidence can produce nearly identical reports. We formalize this as an epistemic Sybil problem. A report Z is an epistemic Sybil extension relative to reports R when I(Theta; Z | R) = 0. No report-only aggregator can generally distinguish replication from independent corroboration: identical reports can warrant different posteriors under unobserved ancestry. A Gaussian shared-root model shows common ancestry does not imply complete redundancy. Repeated extraction adds information toward a source-level ceiling, and correlated extraction errors, which a shared base model can induce among independent agents, lower that ceiling further. translated_title: 认识论女巫抗性：倍增AI智能体而不倍增证据
translated_abstract: 多智能体AI系统通过派生更多智能体并综合其报告来改进推理。但多一个智能体并不等于多一次观测：看似独立的报告可能源自同一份证据，而真正独立的证据也可能产生几乎相同的报告。我们将这一问题形式化为认识论女巫问题：当 I(Θ; Z | R) = 0 时，报告 Z 相对于报告集 R 构成一个认识论女巫扩展。仅基于报告的聚合器通常无法区分复制与独立佐证：在来源谱系不可观测的情况下，相同的报告可以支持不同的后验分布。一个高斯共享根模型表明，共同祖先并不意味着完全冗余：重复抽取会向来源层面的信息上限逼近，而相关的抽取错误——共享的基础模型可能在相互独立的智能体之间诱发此类错误——会进一步降低该上限。我们通过超过20,000次受控的LLM智能体报告与抽取实验检验了这些预测。
tldr: 该论文提出“认识论女巫问题”，指出多智能体AI系统中看似独立的报告可能源自同一证据，证明仅聚合报告无法区分复制与独立佐证，并通过高斯共享根模型与两万余次LLM实验揭示共同祖先及相关抽取错误如何限制证据增益的上限。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes the "epistemic Sybil problem"—in multi-agent AI systems, apparently independent reports may descend from the same evidence—proving that no report-only aggregator can generally distinguish replication from independent corroboration, and using a Gaussian shared-root model with over 20,000 controlled LLM-agent experiments to show how common ancestry and correlated extraction errors bound evidence gains.
